newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Airline to issue hijack plane passenger list Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Airline to issue hijack plane passenger list Sunday.

text.p: Ethiopian Airlines will issue on Sunday a passenger list from the hijacked Ethiopian Airlines plane that crashed near the Comoro Islands on Saturday, a spokesman said.

Ethiopia's Immigration Department, which holds the passenger manifest and boarding pass list, was not available on Saturday evening, Abebe Damassa, spokesman for the airline, told Reuters by telephone.
Forty-seven of the 163 passengers and 12 crew aboard the plane were foreigners from some 21 countries, most of them from Europe, sources close to the airline said.

Ethiopia's President in a message on state television expressed shock and offered condolences to the families of the passengers and crew who died when the plane crashed into the sea after apparently running out of fuel.
He said the accident was "the result of criminal activities by terrorists whose identy and nationality has not yet been established".
So far 45 survivors have been found and 50 people have been confirmed dead in the crash.
